# Brand part photos

Product photos of the HKS, TOMEI and ENDLESS parts the configurator offers for the Evo IX (`PART_SLOTS` in
`src/app.js`), cut out onto a transparent background by `tools/parts-cutout.py`. One file per part id; the ENDLESS
Basic Slit disc photo serves the front and rear disc items. The HKS Hi-Power (US market) exhaust has no official photo,
so the configurator draws an exhaust outline for it.

**These photos are the manufacturers' copyright** (HKS Co., Ltd., Tomei Powered Inc., ENDLESS / Endless Advance),
taken from their own product pages and catalogues for the client's review. Before the site launches, get written
permission or official dealer assets: HKS through Garage R Performance Centre (its distributor for Singapore and
Malaysia), ENDLESS through its Singapore distributor, TOMEI from Tomei Japan (no Singapore distributor found). Where
each photo came from is in `reports/Tomei and HKS Evo IX parts.md` and the research notes.

The client asked for the parts to show only the brand, product name and a short description: no prices, part numbers
or availability. Those, with sourcing and Singapore LTA notes, are in the report.
